company: Ecovalor Consultoria e Assessoria em Sustentabiliade LTDA
mission: To guide organizations towards the best sustainability practices, operating throughout Brazil and offering support to companies of various sectors and sizes.
To deliver sustainability with accuracy, innovation, and simplicity.
vision: To be a reference in the sectors where we operate, admired by our clients and remembered for doing things differently.

mission: To contribute to the improvement of the country's environmental and social conditions, including vulnerable areas, providing health and quality of life.
vision: By 2030, to be nationally recognized for our performance and, especially, for innovation in techniques related to the diagnosis and rehabilitation of contaminated areas, energy recovery from waste, and valuation of sludge from WWTPs.

mission: To promote the conservation, restoration, and socio-economic transformation of Brazilian biomes under pressure from degradation, recalibrating the relationships between companies, individuals, and nature to effectively face the challenges of climate change.
vision: To be recognized as one of the world's leading names in efficient and innovative solutions for companies that want to rethink their relationship with nature, contributing to the construction of a sustainable economy with social justice and environmental preservation.

mission: To transform people and organizations to be better for the world.
vision: To disseminate new ways of doing business that generate positive socio-environmental impact.

mission: Catalyze a globally just and resilient transition to a net-zero economy.
vision: We envision a world in which all organizations actively contribute to the transition to a net-zero global economy, promoting environmental sustainability, social equity and climate resilience.
values: We make positive impacts on society.
We see complementarity in differences and value diversity and freedom of opinion.
We are experts, creating and delivering value internally and externally.
We take pride in what we do and only engage in what we can be proud of.
We delight our customers and build lasting relationships.
We take full responsibility for our actions and foster a sense of teamwork.
